questions.subject: Science
questions.question_text: A current of 0.5 A is drawn by a filament of an electric bulb for 10 minutes. Find the amount of electric charge that flows through the circuit.
questions.answer: We are given, I = 0.5 A; t = 10 min = 600 s. From Eq. (11.1), we have Q=It =0.5 A × 600 s =300 C

questions.subject: Science
questions.question_text: How much work is done in moving a charge of 2 C across two points having a potential difference 12 V?
questions.answer: The amount of charge Q, that flows between two points at potential difference V (= 12 V) is 2 C. Thus, the amount of work W, done in moving the charge [from Eq. (11.2)] is W= VQ = 12 V × 2 C = 24 J.
